final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT e.event_name AS n, AVG(b.amount) AS a FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_name), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.n AS n, s1.a AS a, s1.a - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.m), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s1) SELECT s3.n, s3.a, s3.d, s3.a * 1.0 / s4.m FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.m IS NOT NULL
